newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen ups TF1 to outperform from neutral.
newsitem.headline: SocGen ups TF1 to outperform from neutral.

text.p: Societe Generale raised its recommendation for shares in private French TV company TF1 to "outperform" from "neutral" following a an upward revision to expected subscriptions to Television par Satellite (TPS), according to market sources.
TPS, one of the two French digital satellite television offerings, said last week its forecast for 1997 subscriptions was 250,000 compared with 200,000 previously.
At 1400 GMT, TF1 was up 4.67 percent at 560 francs, after hitting a high of 562 francs earlier on Monday.
